name: Waddle_2
short_caption: The robot places both hands on its hips with elbows out and slightly shifts its body in a waiting stance.
movement_description: The robot lifts both arms symmetrically, bending its elbows outward to rest its hands on its hips in a proud or waiting posture. While holding this hands-on-hips pose, its head and torso gently shift side to side, mimicking a patient but slightly expectant waddle. Finally, the robot lowers both arms back down to its sides, returning to the neutral upright rest position.
safety_notes: The robot elbows extend outwards significantly during the hands-on-hips pose; keep clear of obstacles immediately to its left and right sides.
